calls.statement:
SELECT SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.product_name LIKE 'Interior Paint%'
AND f.store_key = 13
AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-06-29' AND '2026-08-02'

SELECT COUNT(*) as sale_line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.product_name LIKE 'Interior Paint%'
AND f.store_key = 13
AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-06-29' AND '2026-08-02'

SELECT SUM(r.quantity_returned) as units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.product_name LIKE 'Interior Paint%'
AND r.store_key = 13
AND r.return_date BETWEEN '2026-06-29' AND '2026-08-02'

SELECT 
  d.store_name,
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_store d ON f.store_key = d.store_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON f.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE p.product_name LIKE 'Interior Paint%'
AND d.store_id = 108
AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
AND dd.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY d.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
